Macros (C)

Useful sprite-buffer related macros designed to be used in your C programs

Macros
cpctm_spriteBufferPtr

Calculates a pointer inside a sprite-buffer based on (X,Y) coordinates relative to the sprite-buffer space, and WIDTH of the sprite-buffer.

C Definition

#define cpctm_spriteBufferPtr (SPRITE, WIDTH, X, Y)

ASM Call

For asm programs, please refer to cpctm_spriteBufferPtr_asm

Parameters
SPRITE

Pointer to the start of the Sprite-Buffer array

WIDTH

Width in bytes of each line of the Sprite-Buffer Array care with this value not to overlap other parts of the code.

X

X coordinate of the point inside the sprite to be calculated

Y

Y coordinate of the point inside the sprite to be calculated

Known limitations:

  • This macro will produce no-code when used with constant values. If any of the given values is a variable, it will procuce calculation code. This code will be translated by C-compiler into ASM, and may be slow.
